about: Oilers (chapter 6) Noah's touchscreen pull and tap. Patch BY KEY on top of Vico's 2nd cut oilers (export c3273f5772d1, branch cut/vicos-2nd-baseline-20261120, people.cast entries addressed by their `key`). Needs the studio.js stowed-screen commit of this branch (see code_change); without it the screen still jumps when it opens. No other film key changes.
root_causes: A. (code) studio.js setScreenProgress: on a 60x30 desk the open screen is the 'wide' variant, mounted at the 60x30 top's front-right corner (wideMount), but the STOWED screen is the desk model's own Touch_Screen* parts, left where the 48x30 desk has them. The instant the film's touchscreen progress passes 0.001 the stowed parts hide and the wide screen appears 91 mm to the right (room z) and 168 mm nearer the front (room x) of where it was stowed: a 190 mm jump (measured: stowed display centre room (-3327, 1067, -1677), wide display at slide 0 (-3161, 1067, -1585)).

B. (data) Vico's 2nd cut moved Noah 189 mm in room x and 49 mm in room z away from the spot the stand-screen-* postures are built for (tools/people/cast.py: Noah at [-2930, -1080] turn -146, the same placement as the 3rd cut): he stands where the STOWED screen is, so his hand takes it at x -3289 while the screen opens at x -3161 (it appears to his right).
C. (data) the walk's last stride (T 4.8-5.0) swings his right hand into his hip (hand 0.81 of the torso ellipse at T 4.96, solver harness), the posture's own pose is clear (>= 1.4).
vicos_manual_offsets_replaced: people.cast[key=noah-steps].walk.path[2] and the `at` of noah-pulls, noah-taps, noah-watches: [-3119, -1031] (Vico's drag: 189 mm / 49 mm off the built spot) -> [-2930, -1080]. Not needed after fix A+B.

people.cast[key=noah-pulls].postures.people-noah-stand-screen-pull.poseKeys: one key t 5.433 upperarm_r [-0.3238,0.0544,-0.0027,0.9446] lowerarm_r [0.2673,0.0168,-0.0754,0.9605] hand_r [-0.1905,-0.234,0.401,0.8649] (a 38 degree turn pulling the hand 190 mm back toward the screen's edge). Removed: with Noah at the built spot it would carry the hand 190 mm too far.

people.cast[key=noah-steps].postures.people-noah-stand-wait.poseKeys: the same three turns as a single key at t 5.3 (held for the whole walk). Replaced by a window that is active only for the last stride, below.

The 'touchscreen' block ({from 0, open [5.4 -> 0.5 (1.1 s), 6.5 -> 1 (1.1 s)], screen keys}) is IDENTICAL to the cine baseline and to the 3rd cut: nothing of Vico's there; it is what act by [0,0,120] / dur 1.1 is timed to. It stays unchanged.

set.to: (delete the whole postures object: the pull posture as built)

code_change: studio.js setScreenProgress: while a film poses the screen (touchscreenBeforeFilm set) and the desk is 60x30, the stowed Touch_Screen* parts are offset by the wide mount's x/z so the stowed screen stands where the wide screen starts. Only chapters with a `touchscreen` field (oilers only) are changed; the Studio's own Extend screen button is not touched.
